description: Move a role up or down in the server's role hierarchy, which determines permission precedence and member-list ordering. Higher position = higher in the list. Requires the Manage Roles permission, and the target position must be below the bot's highest role.

position.description: New hierarchy position (1 = lowest, just above @everyone, which sits at 0). Higher numbers rank higher.

role_id.description: ID (snowflake) of the role to reposition.

name: discord_set_role_position
